Car road: Car access: adds carbon and lowers health; homes beside it need a safe crossing.
Car park: Parking encourages car trips: more carbon, less health.
Footpath & crossing: Walking route and safe crossing: low carbon, better health.
Cycle lane: Cycle route: very low carbon and good for health.
Tram stop: Public transport: carries many people with little carbon.
Bridge: River crossing, so the two banks are within walking distance.
Timber terrace: Houses 4 households; timber has low embodied carbon and stays warm.
Straw-bale cottages: Houses 3; straw insulates very well and has the lowest embodied carbon.
Rammed-earth homes: Houses 3; rammed earth has thermal mass and modest embodied carbon.
Reclaimed-brick terrace: Houses 4 using reused brick; colder inside without extra insulation.
Cohousing court: Houses 5 with shared space: adds community.
Green roof: Add-on for a home: a little nature and less embodied carbon.
Big field: High yield monoculture: ploughs habitat and adds carbon.
Mixed farm: Balanced yield with low carbon.
Orchard: Some food plus nature; needs pollinators for a full crop.
Allotments: Small yield, but adds community and health.
Vertical farm: High yield in a small space; adds carbon and power demand.
Beehives: Pollinators: boosts orchards and allotments, adds nature.
Plant a hedge: Habitat corridor: adds nature and links wild areas.
Solar roof: Home add-on: power on an average day, none on a still winter night.
Heat pump: Home add-on: clean heating that needs some electricity.
Wind turbine: Power day and night, and cuts carbon.
Battery store: Stores power for when supply is low.
Rain garden: Drains heavy rain; a little nature and health.
Reed bed: Natural water treatment and drainage; adds nature.
Repair café: Cuts waste and carbon; adds community.
Compost hub: Cuts waste and carbon; returns a little food.
Market square: A meeting place: adds community.
Park: Adds health, nature and community.
Green bridge: Wildlife crossing that also shortens walks.
Community hall: Adds community.
Festival field: Adds community and a little health.
